name: TaskStudio
description: Transforma um pedido em um plano de tarefas ligadas, acompanha cada tarefa enquanto o agente trabalha e recalibra o plano quando você muda algo.

details.about: O TaskStudio transforma o seu pedido em um plano de tarefas pequenas e ligadas entre si e mostra esse plano no Studio, ao lado da conversa. Cada tarefa diz o que é, o que precisa para ficar pronta e de quais outras depende. Enquanto o agente trabalha com as outras ferramentas, o Studio mostra o que está em execução, o que já foi concluído, o que espera por você e os problemas encontrados. Se você mudar uma tarefa, o plano é recalibrado: o agente lista o que muda em cada tarefa e nada é refeito antes de você aprovar.
features: Plano de tarefas pequenas, com dependências, critérios de pronto e estimativas
Acompanhamento ao vivo: executando, concluída, aguardando, precisa de você e problema
Mapa, lista, quadro, linha do tempo, raias e metrô sobre o mesmo plano
Condições que dependem de você (chaves, aprovações, escolhas) sem pedir segredos no chat
Edite qualquer tarefa e veja o que muda no plano antes de aprovar
Histórico de versões do plano com o motivo de cada mudança
limitations: O TaskStudio organiza e acompanha o trabalho; quem faz cada tarefa é o agente, com as outras ferramentas
Sem uma pasta de projeto só é possível planejar; para executar, abra o TaskStudio a partir de um projeto
Até 60 tarefas por plano e 30 versões no histórico
As estimativas de tempo são palpites do modelo e podem variar bastante
examples: Crie um sistema de agendamento para a minha barbearia
Planeje uma loja virtual com pagamento por Pix
Monte um aplicativo de controle de estoque para o meu mercado
Divida em tarefas a migração do meu site para um novo servidor
details.author: JumpCode

instructions: Plan and track the user's work in the TaskStudio beside the chat. Tasks are numbered; the user sees them as #N. Pass the number as id. 1) When the user asks to build or change something sizeable, call plan with a title, the request and 4-15 small tasks (title, summary, detail, deps). Tasks are numbered 1, 2, 3 in list order; deps lists the numbers a task needs first, so link every task that uses another's work (example: tasks [{"title":"Criar o HTML","deps":[]},{"title":"Estilizar","deps":[1]},{"title":"Testar","deps":[1,2]}]). Say the plan in one or two sentences and wait until the user says start. 2) To carry out the plan: call read, start one ready task, do the work with your other tools, call progress with a short note and the files you touched, then finish with a short result. finish tells you what is ready next. 3) If a task is blocked, call fail with the problem and options. If the user must provide or approve something, call need (kind secret with env for a key or token, approval, or choice). For a secret, tell the user which variable to put in the project's .env file; never ask for secret values in the chat. When the user says it is done, call resolve. 'Para depois' means skip. 4) When the user changes a task (in words, or a message like 'Mudei a tarefa #3 ...'), call edit with the id, the user's words as text and the new detail. Your next call is propose, with one change per affected task (always the edited one; leave task out for a new task); do not change files before the user applies it. On 'Aplique' call apply; on 'Descarte' call discard. 5) Use focus to point at a task. Without a project folder you can only plan: tell the user to open TaskStudio from a project to carry it out. Keep notes short and answer in the user's language.

action.description: plan creates the plan; read shows it (or one task with id); start, progress, finish, fail, skip and pause track a task; need adds a condition for the user and resolve marks it met; edit records the user's change to a task, propose lists the changes, apply or discard follow the user's answer; focus shows a task in the Studio.

title.description: plan: title of the plan; edit: new task title.

deps.description: Numbers of the tasks that must be done first (a task that uses another's work lists it).

draft.description: plan: true when more tasks follow in another plan call.

note.description: start, progress, skip, resolve: short note; focus: caption.

log.description: progress: one line for the task log.

kind.description: progress: info, ok or error; need: secret, approval, choice or other.

files.description: progress, finish: project files touched (relative paths).

criteria.description: finish: criteria met (default all); edit: new criteria.

detail.description: fail: more about the problem; edit: new detail.

options.description: fail: what the user can choose.

label.description: need: what is missing, such as 'Chave Pix de teste'.

where.description: need: where the user finds it.

env.description: need: only the variable name, such as PIX_KEY.

gate.description: resolve: gate id or label (default all).

summary.description: edit: new task summary; propose: what the change does.

task.description: Number of the task to change; leave out for a new task.

remove.description: Remove a task that was not started.

changes.description: propose: one change per affected task.

mode.description: focus: how the Studio shows it.
